purpose: Prove that the reusable Leverage engine can coordinate a real project through the business loop without being tied to one product type or platform.

test_project.note: Gumroad is the test channel instance, not the Leverage architecture.

loop.evidence: project exists and customer problem is defined
product was selected as the first zero-cost experiment
product is live on the selected marketplace channel
authoritative traffic execution is not connected; external distribution requires approved channel execution
requires measurable traffic and verified funnel data
verified sales/revenue state exists; traffic source is not connected

success_criteria: No fabricated traffic, sales, revenue or customer evidence
All external publishing/outreach remains approval gated
Every completed stage has observable evidence
The same engine can represent a different project type without changing core lifecycle logic
next_action: Connect an authoritative channel measurement source or approved free distribution execution path, then re-run the gate evaluation.
